verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a public GraphQL API for querying New Relic data and configuring features. It is backed by an API explorer and an official CLI that emits machine-readable JSON for CI/CD and scripted use, so the product can be driven programmatically. The documentation says NerdGraph configures only 'some' features, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: evidence that every product feature can be configured via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
An easy way to experiment with the NerdGraph API is to use the NerdGraph API explorer.
Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
